notablePrerequisites:
Ill-Tempered Loner can be transformed.
You have a way to deal damage to Ill-Tempered Loner.
description:
Cast Angelfire Ignition by paying {1}{R}{W}, giving Ill-Tempered Loner lifelink and indestructible until end of turn.
Deal damage to Ill-Tempered Loner.
Ill-Tempered Loner triggers, dealing 2 damage to itself and causing you to gain two life.
Repeat step 3.
